Feast of St. Muirgen (Lí Ban the Mermaid)

A Day of Reflection and Coastal Comfort: Celebrating St. Muirgen

On January 27th, honor St. Muirgen, Lí Ban the Mermaid, with a day dedicated to reflection, the sea, and traditional Irish fare, bringing the spirit of the loughs to your home.

  1. Morning

    The Mermaid's Tale

    Begin your day by reading the enchanting tale of Lí Ban from the Annals of the Four Masters, tracing her miraculous transformation and journey.

  2. Late Morning

    A Walk by the Water

    Take a contemplative walk by a local body of water, or simply spend a quiet moment reflecting on the vastness of the sea and those who navigate its depths.

  3. Lunch

    Coastal Appetizers

    Enjoy a light, refreshing lunch featuring the delicate flavors of the Irish coast, a nod to Muirgen's origins.

    Recipes: Baked Bangor Oysters with Garlic Herb Butter · Brown Soda Bread with Salted Butter

  4. Afternoon

    Preparing the Main Feast

    Take your time to prepare the centerpiece of your evening meal, allowing the aromas of the sea to fill your kitchen.

  5. Early Evening

    A Guiding Light for Sailors

    As dusk approaches, light a candle in your home, a symbolic beacon for sailors and all who make their living from the sea, remembering Muirgen's patronage.

  6. Dinner

    The Sea-Born Supper

    Gather to enjoy a nourishing feast centered around poached Irish salmon, celebrating the rich bounty of the waters that sustained Lí Ban.

    Recipes: Poached Irish Salmon · Brown Soda Bread with Salted Butter

  7. Late Evening

    Sweet Endings and Warm Spirits

    Conclude your day with a traditional dulse and carrageen pudding, paired with a comforting pot of tea or a warming measure of Bushmills whiskey.

    Recipes: Dulse and Carrageen Pudding · Classic Brewed Black Tea · Lí Ban's Seafoam Whiskey Cocktail

May the spirit of St. Muirgen bring peace and reflection to your home, connecting you to the ancient tales and the enduring power of the sea.
